decisions.reason: The lead-free requirement from this source is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message INTRODUCE Event; the QR-code change does not further alter it.
Requiring a QR code and lead-free construction does not change the required contents of the power-board production package.
The source establishes board markings and a lead-free constraint but does not change component availability, sourcing checks, or fallback rules.
The source does not change which sensor-board production files must be delivered; any revised board design can use the existing package requirements unchanged.
The QR-code and lead-free decision does not establish or modify any main-board production-package attribute.
Board identification and lead-free requirements do not change the task of reviewing component orientations.
The source does not change manufacturing-account access, cart setup, or the setup acceptance condition.
The QR-code and lead-free requirements do not alter ESP32 pin access, breakout technology, module pin count, or header assembly requirements.
The source does not change sensor logic levels, level-shifter footprints, or the future adapter-board policy.
The source does not alter interboard connector types, pin assignments, signal architecture, or matching-numbering requirements.
Requiring QR codes and lead-free boards does not change the main-board decoupling requirement.
The source does not change panel controls, connector coverage, GPIO mappings, button placement, or panel wiring.
